articles.summary: KEY POINTS : MasterBrand, Inc. surveyed more than 2,000 kitchen designers to identify emerging trends and favored materials shaping kitchens in 2027. Reemerging wood finishes, including light- and medium-toned stains, reflect a shift toward warmer, more natural kitchen designs. MasterBrand Cabinets' 2027 Impactful Finish of the Year is Kanga, a warm mid-tone stain that showcases the beauty of wood grain. MasterBrand, Inc. (NYSE: MBC) released its annual trends report today, informed by more than 2,000 kitchen design experts across North America. The report highlights a shift toward richer, nature-inspired materials, the need for multifunctional spaces and the debut of the 2027 Impactful Finish of the Year, Kanga*. Together, these trends reflect a growing desire for kitchens that balance functionality with warmth and personalization. "Modern kitchens are multifunctional spaces tailored to support the way homeowners gather and work in their homes," said Stephanie Pierce, senior director
articles.title: Kitchen Design Aesthetics and Trends: MasterBrand, Inc. Unveils 2027 Cabinetry Trends and Finish of the Year
